institutionName: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was importnat for me to chose a destination where i could live close to nature and outdoor opportunities. Tromsø was the perfect destination for this that also had interesting courses

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was quite easy, i think that UIT was good at informing by e-mail. They were also very kind to help if needed to speak with someone in person upon arrival.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: didnt really receive any assistance when i arrived. But this was als not needed. I think that once i was there and met other Erasmus students everything was quite easy.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
I lived in private housing in an apartment with two Norwegian girls. This was okay easy to find on
Hybel.no
- especially for a scandinavian.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I can highly recommend living in a private housing off campus. I think it is good to know that i seemed like people who didnt speak a scandinavian language found it more difficult to find private housing. But if you do speak, Norwegian, danish or sweden it really shouldn't be a problem - go for it! can only reccomend.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: in the intro week we had to registre. Unfourtunatly i got sick this day and had to figure out how to register another, which there was no problem in, however i think it was a bit strange and not really optimal that you could only do this one day...

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: UIT students helped organize the thing and where availible to ask for questions

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: 100% succesful. i think this process however was very unorganized and chaotic. here the some of the people who answered the emails on the uit help e-mail were absolutly no help, and i needed to wait to get the correct courses until i came to Tromsø. That was a bit stressfull, but everything turned out completly fine.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: be sure to know what dates all of this is possible and have printed the correct papers out in advance.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: i think the level of courses were lower at UIT than at KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: it was very much the same type of teaching methods. lectures and in some courses also lab work and classes.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Arctic Norway - Aspects of culture
Immunology 
Marine Biotechnology

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Immunology : was a super interesting course and the teacher was absolutely amazing. very helpfull and just good at teaching. 
Marine Biotechnology : was a super chill course but also interesting. Read a lot of very interesting courses.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: I used a lot of money on trips - lofoten, svalbard and so on. this costed a bit more than expected

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: beer and food is extremely expenssive. However it was possible to borrow outdoor gear (tents, sleeping bags etc.) for free in TURBO in the city.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: i joined the Diving club which was amazing. can highly recommend. and also the kajak club through TSI.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
go hiking to the cabins in tromsdalen on days where you dont have class. This is easy accesible and such beautiful views and cheep if you become a member at DNT. 
when the snow hits - by a pair of langred skies.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
just go on all kinds of trips when you have the possibility. 
- lofoten was amazing for hiking. 
i also went on a trip with the diving club , which was amazing. i think more of the TSI groups organize trips - do that! also a great way to met people

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: very easy. the culture isnt thaaat different from denmark and you can understand each other speaking dansih - Norweigian. this made it a lot easier and people are in general just super nice.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: join groups, and go on trips with new poeple - its the easiest and fastest way to make friends.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: nope

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: the mindset about outdoor activities and the nature is just different in a really good and motivating way

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: it takes time to make friends. dont get stressed about this. you will meet people who are in the same poistion and want to make friends.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: X

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: the experiences i got and the amazing people i have met from around the world as well as from copenhagen.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: not stressing about doing everything all the time. attending every social gathering with out getting FOMO. dont stress you have plenty of time!

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: go to tromsø

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
